newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia to sell stake in main fertiliser firm.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia to sell stake in main fertiliser firm.

text.p: Tunisia wants investors to buy the majority of shares in the country's main fertiliser firm Societe Tunisienne d'Engrais Chimiques STEC as part of its privatisation programme, officials at the Economic Development ministry said on Friday.

The tender is for a 53.76 percent stake in STEC's capital of five million dinars ($five million). The capital is held by the Tunisian state and its two chemical firms, Groupe Chimique and Compagnie des Phosphates de Gafsa.
STEC markets locally-made and imported fertilisers.
Its 1995 turnover was 50 million dinars and net profit 300,000 dinars.
